subject: Life Skills
title: Statute of Limitations Basics
description: A quick win: understand Statute of Limitations Basics.

hook.text: A creditor tried to sue over a 15-year-old debt. The case was thrown out because the deadline passed.

buildup.text: The statute of limitations sets a deadline for filing lawsuits. It varies by type and by state.

discovery.text: Contract disputes and personal injury cases usually have limits between two and six years.

twist.text: Making a partial payment on old debt can restart the clock. Collectors count on people not knowing this.

climax.text: Check your state's limits before responding to old claims. Time may have already run out in your favor.

punchline.text: Old debts can expire. Know when the clock stops.

quiz.question: What can restart the statute of limitations on an old debt?
options: Making a partial payment on the debt
